email_subject: Application - Social Media Content Creator at The ASH
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Flexi-job Social Media Content Creator position at The ASH. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media integration, and SEO, I am confident I can bring The ASH's unique atmosphere to life on Instagram and TikTok.

In my current role at Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, which has sharpened my eye for detail and my ability to produce engaging, polished content. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a website with integrated social media, and I regularly use Canva for design. I am comfortable filming and editing with a smartphone, and I am eager to learn CapCut if needed.

I am social by nature and enjoy connecting with people, which makes interviewing guests and creating spontaneous content a natural fit. I speak fluent English and Turkish, and my Dutch is at B1 level and improving.

I would love to contribute to The ASH's vibrant community. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

I am social by nature and enjoy connecting with people from all walks of life, which makes interviewing guests and creating spontaneous content a natural fit. Warm regards,
